title: DataNode packet serving exceptions during peer transfer
log_pattern: WARN dfs.DataNode$DataXceiver: Got exception while serving blk_* to /*
symptoms: Multiple DataNodes report exceptions while serving blocks to peer nodes. Block replication appears to stall intermittently.
root_cause: Network instability or peer DataNode overload during block replication. When a receiving DataNode is slow or the network link degrades, the sending DataNode's socket write times out mid-transfer, throwing the exception.
fix: Checked network utilization on the affected rack, found a saturated top-of-rack switch during a large replication job. Throttled replication bandwidth and the exceptions dropped to baseline within 20 minutes.

title: Repeated Unknown base file warnings in Nova compute image cache
symptoms: Same warning repeats every ~40 seconds for the same base image hash. No user-facing impact observed initially.
root_cause: A base image was deleted from the image cache directory while VM instances still referenced it in tracking metadata. The periodic image cache manager keeps polling for it.
fix: Confirmed no active instances depended on the missing base. Cleared the imagecache manager's stale tracking entry to stop the repeated poll.

title: Repeated SSH authentication failures from single external IP
log_pattern: authentication failure; logname= uid=0 euid=0 tty=NODEVssh
symptoms: Dozens of failed SSH login attempts within a short window, all from the same external IP, targeting root and common usernames.
root_cause: Automated SSH brute-force scan from an external host, not a system fault.
fix: Confirmed no successful logins occurred. Added the source IP to the firewall deny list and enabled fail2ban with a 3-attempt threshold.

title: HDFS block replication under-count after DataNode restart
log_pattern: WARN dfs.FSNamesystem: BLOCK* NameSystem.chooseTarget: Not able to place enough replicas
symptoms: NameNode reports under-replicated blocks after a batch of DataNodes were restarted for maintenance.
root_cause: More DataNodes were restarted simultaneously than the replication factor could tolerate.
fix: Paused remaining restarts, let the replication monitor catch up, then resumed restarts one node at a time.

title: Nova API elevated response latency during instance list queries
symptoms: GET servers/detail and GET /v2/project/servers/detail requests that normally take 0.25s start taking 3-9 seconds during peak load.
root_cause: Unindexed join across instances and instance_metadata tables causing a full table scan as tenant instance counts grew.
fix: Added a composite index on project_id and deleted columns. Query time dropped from 3-9s back to under 0.3s.

title: Spark executor silent restart with no error logged
symptoms: Executor restarts mid-job with a fresh startup log line but no preceding error.
root_cause: YARN preempted the executor container to reclaim resources for a higher-priority queue job.
fix: Cross-referenced YARN logs, confirmed container preemption. No fix needed, documented as expected behavior in the runbook.

title: Kafka consumer lag spike after partition leader election
symptoms: Consumers report commit failures and lag increases sharply after a broker restart. Processing resumes slowly but offsets remain behind.
root_cause: Partition leadership moved during broker maintenance and consumers were rebalancing while the coordinator was unavailable.
fix: Paused the deployment, confirmed controller stability, restarted affected consumer group members one at a time, and monitored lag until it returned to baseline.

title: Kubernetes pod crash loop from missing ConfigMap key
log_pattern: Warning BackOff kubelet: Back-off restarting failed container
symptoms: Deployment rolls out successfully but new pods enter CrashLoopBackOff immediately. Previous ReplicaSet remains healthy and the failed container reports a missing required environment variable.
root_cause: A required environment variable was mapped from a ConfigMap key that was not present in the target namespace.
fix: Restored the missing ConfigMap key, restarted the deployment, and added a pre-deploy validation check for required keys.

title: PostgreSQL connection pool exhaustion during batch job
log_pattern: FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections
symptoms: API requests intermittently fail with database connection errors while a nightly job is running.
root_cause: The batch job opened one connection per worker and bypassed the shared pool, exhausting the database connection limit.
fix: Reduced batch worker concurrency, routed the job through PgBouncer, and added pool saturation alerts.

title: Redis eviction storm after cache memory limit reached
log_pattern: WARNING overcommit_memory is set to 0; Background save may fail under low memory condition
symptoms: Cache hit rate drops and API latency rises. Redis reports frequent key evictions and memory pressure.
root_cause: A new feature cached large serialized responses without TTLs, pushing Redis past maxmemory and causing aggressive eviction.
fix: Added TTLs to the new cache keys, reduced payload size, and increased the maxmemory limit for the shard.

title: Nginx upstream timeout from saturated application workers
log_pattern: upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out) while reading response header from upstream
symptoms: Users receive intermittent 504 responses while the load balancer and network remain healthy.
root_cause: Application workers were blocked on slow downstream calls, so Nginx timed out waiting for response headers.
fix: Rolled back the downstream call fan-out change, raised worker concurrency temporarily, and added timeout budgets.

title: Airflow DAG stuck because scheduler lost database heartbeat
log_pattern: ERROR airflow.jobs.scheduler_job: Scheduler heartbeat got an exception
symptoms: Scheduled DAGs stop launching while workers are idle. Existing tasks finish but no new task instances are queued.
root_cause: The scheduler process lost its metadata database heartbeat after transient database failover.
fix: Restarted the scheduler, verified metadata DB connectivity, and added a health check on scheduler heartbeat freshness.

title: Elasticsearch shard allocation blocked by disk watermark
log_pattern: high disk watermark exceeded on one or more nodes
symptoms: Index health turns yellow and new replicas remain unassigned after a traffic spike.
root_cause: One data node crossed the high disk watermark, so Elasticsearch stopped allocating shards to it.
fix: Deleted expired indices, moved a large shard away from the hot node, and lowered index retention for noisy logs.

title: S3 object ingestion failures from expired IAM session token
log_pattern: botocore.exceptions.ClientError: An error occurred (ExpiredToken) when calling the PutObject operation
symptoms: Ingestion workers fail to upload objects after running normally for several hours.
root_cause: Workers cached temporary IAM credentials and did not refresh the session token before expiration.
fix: Restarted workers to refresh credentials and patched the client factory to renew sessions before token expiry.

title: Celery task backlog from stuck broker connection
log_pattern: consumer: Cannot connect to amqp://guest:**@rabbitmq:5672//: timed out
symptoms: Task queue depth grows while workers appear alive but do not consume new messages.
root_cause: Workers kept stale RabbitMQ connections after broker failover and did not reconnect cleanly.
fix: Restarted affected workers, enabled broker heartbeat checks, and reduced connection retry backoff.

title: Prometheus scrape failures after service port rename
log_pattern: server returned HTTP status 404 Not Found for /metrics
symptoms: Dashboards show missing metrics for a service after a deployment, but the service itself is serving traffic.
root_cause: The Kubernetes Service port name changed and the ServiceMonitor continued scraping the old metrics endpoint.
fix: Updated the ServiceMonitor selector and added a deployment check that validates the metrics endpoint.

title: DNS resolution failures from stale CoreDNS cache
log_pattern: plugin/errors: 2 service.default.svc.cluster.local. A: read udp i/o timeout
symptoms: Pods intermittently fail to resolve internal service names even though endpoints are healthy.
root_cause: CoreDNS pods kept stale upstream resolver state after a node network interruption.
fix: Restarted CoreDNS pods, verified upstream resolver reachability, and lowered cache TTL for internal service lookups.

title: GitHub Actions workflow failures from exhausted runner disk
symptoms: CI jobs fail during dependency installation and Docker layer extraction. Retrying on the same runner fails again.
root_cause: Build artifacts and Docker layers from earlier jobs filled the ephemeral runner disk.
fix: Added cleanup steps before Docker builds, pruned unused layers, and reduced cached artifact size.
